scope: First guided engineering attempt preparation and attachment-token defect investigation

blockers.observation: After changing catalog ownership, chmod failed under the restricted capability set.
blockers.correction: Set mode before changing owner; retain the existing restricted capabilities.
blockers.release_engineer_verification: Independently reproduced on development Linux; corrected private helper passed 19 offline tests.

blockers.observation: Strict read-only policy verification rejected differing target and loader attachment tokens across container mounts.
blockers.release_engineer_reproduction: Separate development Linux container mounts exposed the same boot ID, USB bus/address and sysfs inode with differing ctime values.
blockers.correction: Versioned linux-usb-kernfs64-v1 token uses host boot ID, USB bus/address and the full 64-bit kernfs node ID; requires native supported 64-bit Linux and genuine sysfs; coherent repeated metadata samples must match.

source_fix_validation.fresh_container_production_token_compari: passed with different mount namespaces and ctime values
source_fix_validation.development_probe_limit: The production LinuxUSB inventory used an offline CH340 transport fixture backed by real USB root-hub generation metadata. This does not qualify the HA radio transport.

qualification.next_gate: Clean-commit replacement image and isolated new attempt; compare actual radio metadata across fresh containers before stopping original service. Create and verify a fresh exact-unit policy without modifying the failed attempt.
